g.text: BHARAT JODO YATRA
ENDS IN SRINAGAR
The march that began in Kanyakumari closed
after covering about four thousand
kilometres on foot. Supporters gathered in
the snow for the final rally as organisers
thanked volunteers from every state. The

RECORD TURNOUT AS
INDIA VOTES
Long queues formed at polling booths from
early morning as voters in towns and
villages turned out in large numbers.
Officials said first-time voters and women
were seen in strength across districts,
and counting is scheduled under heavy
security. Long queues formed at polling

CONGRESS WINS
KARNATAKA WITH 135
SEATS
The party crossed the majority mark
comfortably in the 224-member assembly.
Leaders credited a campaign built on local
issues, guarantees for households and a
steady ground operation in every district.

RAHUL GANDHI TAKES
CHARGE AS LEADER
OF OPPOSITION
The appointment fills a post that had
stayed vacant for a decade. Allies
welcomed the move and said the opposition
would press for debate on jobs, prices and
the conduct of institutions. The
appointment fills a post that had stayed
